draw.method: random.Random(52941119). Shippable = candidate 'likely' groups whose category is not held (junkyard_scraper._oem_held / GROUP_HOLD_CATS): 225 of 228 (3 wiper-motor held). Ids sorted within each category; quota = largest remainder of 30*n_cat/225; rng.sample per category in sorted category order; then rng.sample(30) of the remaining 195 sorted ids; per pair group the vehicle-years are expanded from apps and sorted, seeker = rng.choice, donor = rng.choice of the rest.

replay: lot replayed with a copy of audit11_4/lot_replay.mjs that only adds per-car output (verdict, warn, decode); the app code it runs is extracted from docs/app.js unchanged; payload apps from junkyard_scraper._oem_gated_apps
standard: A row is judged as the app shows it (lot replay). Build windows: a model year is taken as Aug y-1..Jul y unless the pages show otherwise; when the claimed number's own dated window leaves 3+ months of that year to another listed number (predecessor or successor), a plain row with no build-date line is WRONG, because the catalog's 'Replaced By' runs one way and a car built with one number is offered the other. 1-2 months is RISK. The leading '*' on 'Fitting Vehicle Options' clauses is not explained anywhere in the raw; where it decides a drive or engine scope the item is RISK. Trim-only splits (XE/SE, LE, Journey, Leather) are carried by the group's 'option' note and are not counted against it. Where a vehicle-year has no lists.jsonl page but the product record's seed is that page, its list_info is taken as that page's row.

build_window_flaw.method: tools: own-page dated window of the claimed number, or a dated predecessor (Replaced By the claimed number) on any page of the same model, leaving 3+ months of the nominal Aug-Jul model year to another number, on a vehicle-year with no built gate. Mechanical and approximate (page dates are clipped to each page's range; borderline 3-month cases included). It does not catch an unrelated sibling number dated only on another year's page (the Sentra 2004 case).
